title: features.json — the module's feature list (authored, never derived)
description: The feature spine: every id is referenced by at least one check-hints/<child>.json source_feature (enforced by check-crossrefs), and the simulation-plan agent derives testpoints and tests from these entries. Authored by the specification stage's Wave 1; design.md §1.3 points here and carries no table. Values are free prose — no script parses inside a field. Only id / name / description are required: the rest are the shape a feature record USUALLY takes, and a required-non-empty box buys a filled box, not a real answer. Write the ones this feature actually has.

id.description: The feature identifier check-hints source_feature values and testpoints refer to.

name.description: Short label. Reaches the TB testlist and the human-read case-results summary.

description.description: What the feature is, including any RTL formula that pins it.

mode_interface.description: Optional. The interface group or operating mode this feature exercises.

priority.description: Optional. Free text — the vocabulary is the project's, not this schema's.

negative_cases.description: Optional. Behaviour on invalid or out-of-contract stimulus.

coverage_intent.description: Optional coverage goal. Absent means absent; nothing substitutes a value.
